thread:
olivia (AP): Heads up: LegacyVendor US sent INV-LG-9001 for $42,000 but PO field is blank. This is a prepaid subscription renewal that slipped through. Auto-match failed.
approvals-bot: Invoice INV-LG-9001 queued. Auto-match error: missing PO.
legacy-vendor-us: Hi team, apologies 1 we billed the renewal from legacy billing platform and it didn't include PO-legacy. This invoice is for annual prepaid subscription (contract says PO optional for renewals). Can Redwood accept as-is to avoid service interruption?
marc (Procurement): Contract clause 2.1 for legacy subscriptions allows invoicing without PO if paid via procurement-approved renewal schedule, but Procurement needs confirmation that renewal was authorized last year. Do we have a renewal approval doc?
olivia (AP): I can't find a renewal approval in Coupa. The contract has a note about auto-renew but no explicit PO. AP will hold payment until an exception or PO is provided.
dina (FP&A): If this lapses, services may be paused impacting infra budget. We had CAPEX flagged for this subscription; paying on time prevents downstream monthly reforecast pain. Can Procurement confirm approval so Finance can sign an exception?
marc (Procurement): If GL is pre-authorized and C-level approved auto-renew was documented, Procurement can mark as "procured" and create a retro PO. Need evidence: previous renewal email or finance approval.
legacy-vendor-us: We can provide the renewal confirmation email thread from 2025-11-15 where Redwood's procurement replied "ack". Attaching now.
olivia (AP): attaching vendor email snippet: "Redwood Procurement acknowledged renewal 2025-11-15, request to bill."
marc (Procurement): That should suffice. I'll create retro PO PO-RETRO-2026-17 and tag the invoice. But policy requires a director-level exception for retro POs >$25k. @elaine can you sign?
elaine (Finance Dir): I'll sign the procurement exception if FP&A signs off on budget impact. Dina, confirm GL and that this fits approved spend.
dina (FP&A): GL: 6205-Platform-Subscriptions. Confirmed within approved FY26 vendor spend cap. No P&L impact beyond timing.
elaine (Finance Dir): Signed. Please create exception ticket EXC-11400: "retro PO for legacy subscription invoice >25k" and route to me for final sign-off.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-11400 created and signed by Elaine (Finance Dir). Status: completed.
olivia (AP): Retro PO PO-RETRO-2026-17 created and attached to INV-LG-9001. Applied payment scheduling. Will process payment next run to avoid service interruption.
legacy-vendor-us: Thanks Redwood team. We'll confirm receipt and keep service active. Appreciate quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
